summary: VisionWave Holdings, Inc. filed Form 8-K to disclose termination of a binding agreement to acquire 51% of Meteor Aerospace Ltd. at a $40M pre-money valuation. The termination followed due diligence, effective August 13, 2026. No consideration was paid, no shares issued, and no penalties incurred. As acquirer, VisionWave walked away before closing, leaving no financial exposure. The filing serves as a deal termination notice, with no board recommendation or advisors named. Watch for potential strategic pivot or new acquisition targets, though no risk-arb opportunity exists as the deal never closed.
